The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ktg_006
steps:
  - id: receive_request
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      schema: claim_status_report_request
      required_fields:
        - date_range_start
        - date_range_end
        - audience
        - filters
    output: report_request

  - id: authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{report_request.auth_token}}"
    output: auth_context

  - id: log_report_request
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: claim_status_report_requested
      user: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
      details:
        audience: "{{report_request.audience}}"
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"

  - id: parallel_data_reads
    op: parallel_execute
    params:
      branches:
        - step_ref: read_employer_summary
        - step_ref: read_activity_data
        - step_ref: read_medical_data
        - step_ref: read_litigation_data
        - step_ref: read_lost_time_data
        - step_ref: read_incident_data

  - id: read_employer_summary
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: employer_summary
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: employer_data

  - id: read_activity_data
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: activity_data
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        categories:
          - FCM
          - IME
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: activity_data

  - id: read_medical_data
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: medical_data
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: medical_data

  - id: read_litigation_data
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: litigation_data
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: litigation_data

  - id: read_lost_time_data
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: lost_time_data
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: lost_time_data

  - id: read_incident_data
    op: read_database
    params:
      tenant: "{{auth_context.tenant_id}}"
      table: incident_data
      filters:
        date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
        date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
        custom_filters: "{{report_request.filters}}"
    output: incident_data

  - id: merge_all_categories
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      sources:
        - "{{employer_data}}"
        - "{{activity_data}}"
        - "{{medical_data}}"
        - "{{litigation_data}}"
        - "{{lost_time_data}}"
        - "{{incident_data}}"
      labels:
        - employer
        - activity
        - medical
        - litigation
        - lost_time
        - incident
    output: merged_data

  - id: aggregate_report
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      source: "{{merged_data}}"
      group_by:
        - category
        - audience
      metrics:
        - count
        - totals
        - averages
      audience: "{{report_request.audience}}"
    output: aggregated_report

  - id: apply_audience_rules
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: audience_report_variant
      audience: "{{report_request.audience}}"
      date_range_start: "{{report_request.date_range_start}}"
      date_range_end: "{{report_request.date_range_end}}"
      data: "{{aggregated_report}}"
    output: variant_report

  - id: format_html_report
    op: format_output
    params:
      format: html
      template: claim_status_report
      data: "{{variant_report}}"
      print_optimized: true
    output: html_report

  - id: log_report_generated
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: claim_status_report_generated
      user: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
      details:
        audience: "{{report_request.audience}}"
        variant: "{{variant_report.variant_id}}"
        record_count: "{{variant_report.record_count}}"

  - id: handle_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: terminate
      notify: "{{auth_context.user_id}}"
      message: "Claim status report generation failed."
